title: brown butter chocolate-chip cookies 🍪 ..nearly two years later
description: brown butter chocolate-chip cookies 🍪 ..nearly two years later
transcript: Stop. I made this video about two years ago now and so I'm redoing the voiceover because not gonna lie people still watch that one and I don't know when I rewatch it I hate it but this is still the only chocolate chip cookie recipe you will ever need. It starts with brown butter which means you cook the butter just until the milk solids become toasted which brings out this nutty flavor that you don't really get with just regular melted butter. This elevates the flavor of any baked goods so I highly recommend. The formula for any cookie goes like this. Fat, sugar, binding agent, leavening agent and flour. Flavors and mix-ins you can play around with but of course our never-fail combo is vanilla and dark chocolate chunks. Never chips. And there you have it the science or math of a cookie.
